title: Potato and Toast American Breakfast
description: A filling breakfast recipe using potato and toast for a delicious start to the day.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Slice the potato into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Place the potato slices in the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Meanwhile, toast the bread until lightly browned.
Assemble the breakfast by placing a cooked potato slice on top of a slice of toasted bread, followed by a slice of American cheese.
Repeat the layers one more time to create a stacked breakfast sandwich.
